I'm an MBA candidate at **University Canada West**, with a B.Sc. in **Agriculture (TNAU, 2018–2022)**. I focus on **marketing strategy**, **product thinking**, and **AI-assisted analysis**. This site expands my one-page portfolio into a multi-page view of my work, skills, and interests.

## Highlights

- **Marketing Report — Netflix Advertising** (BUSI 654): 1,500–2,000 words, APA-style; used LLMs for outline ideation and Quarto for publishing.
- **Organizational Diagnosis — MyChef Connex**: Focused on staffing for remote camps in BC; identified seasonality, marketing gaps, and gatekeeping risks.
- **CompassTap (Student Transit App)**: Venture concept combining navigation, real-time updates, and student discounts for Metro Vancouver.
